dialogues.speaker: The Chasm Mining Archive
dialogues.text: "...The elemental reactions within The Chasm have, over its long history, turned the soil a wondrous violet-red..."

dialogues.speaker: The Chasm Mining Archive
dialogues.text: "...The Glazed Sand Crystal that can be gathered and processed from within has an almost unearthly, lovely luster to it..."

dialogues.speaker: The Chasm Mining Archive
dialogues.text: "...The tradition of processing Glazed Sand Crystal has played a massive part in the fame that Liyue's porcelain goods have won..."
